authorization.python: Python 3.13 is the active full qualification/CI target. Preserve compatibility fixes; a bounded selected Python 3.14 probe may be run at root direction, without adding a 3.14 CI matrix or implying full qualification. Do not justify retirement by universal Python 3.14 failure: NumPy 2.2.6 source-build audit succeeded and standalone LeRobot resolves an older stack. Root refreshed stack conflicts with LeRobot 0.6.1 constraints.
authorization.delivery: Implementation may start in an isolated worktree/branch now; integration, PR delivery and merge are ordered after Phase 2 PR 417 CI acceptance. Root owns serialized shared files, publication and merge. Existing user authorization covers routine model selection, necessary fixes and validation; no additional permission is required.

selected_model.rationale: Small 2025 Qwen3 base causal model; native Transformers AutoModelForCausalLM support, explicit Apache-2.0 license, no remote code, no new training engine, no multimodal processor, no quantization/native extension dependency. Base variant directly suits bounded plain-text causal-LM adaptation and perplexity evaluation, avoiding chat/thinking-template requirements.
selected_model.recency_limit: Modern small text-only reference, not the newest Qwen release. Qwen3.5 is newer but its distributed checkpoint is multimodal.
selected_model.upstream_min_transformers: 4.51.0; refreshed root has 5.18.0. Native source exists locally; this is not yet a real-weight compatibility test.
selected_model.resource_estimates: ~1.2 GB BF16 serialized weights and ~2.4 GB FP32 parameter memory; peak training RSS must be measured, not inferred from these minima. Run clients serially or on a suitable dedicated worker to bound peak memory.

alternatives.reason_not_selected: Official config is Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration (qwen3_5) with text_config and vision_config; existing loader expects AutoModelForCausalLM. Requires explicit checkpoint/text-backbone integration and mixed-attention/vision decisions, widening a text-only replacement.
Native SmolLM3ForCausalLM and recent open model, but about 3.075B parameters impose substantially larger smoke/CI resources.

Useful later instruction-tuning variant; chat/thinking semantics add unnecessary requirements to a plain causal-LM replacement. API currently reports 751632384 stored parameters; do not substitute its weights while retaining the Base pin.
